{{Quote|Essentially, she narrows her focus&ndash;her mind and Force-awareness&ndash;until it becomes microscopic. While her physical body remains unchanged, her projected form shrinks to an infinitesimal size. In that state, she can rearrange molecules, take them apart, and build new ones bit by bit.|Cilghal, upon learning Art of the Small from Vergere|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
'''Art of the Small''' was a radical and advanced [[Force power/Legends|Force method]] of melding oneself with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Under [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]], a Force user's presence shrank to a microscopic size. While in this state, the user could operate molecules in any way they wanted, turning them into something completely different.

==Description==
The Art of the Small used to be a challenging [[Force power/Legends|Alter]]-based [[The Force/Legends|Force]] ability among the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] which was expected to take talented [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] a year or two in order to become an expert.<ref name="Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> Through shrinking the Force presence to that of a single atom, it allowed for an unprecedented degree of stealth as well as allowing for a perception of the universe on a molecular scale. Using [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] in this [[Meditation/Legends|meditative]] state allows [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to eliminate toxins and cure certain ailments in others as well as in themselves by constructing healthy proteins and rebuilding cells.<ref name="Jedi Path" />

==Applications==
With the power to alter things at a molecular level, a Force-user could have many uses for such a technique.

As demonstrated by [[Vergere]], the failed [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] who named it, the Art of the Small could be employed to conceal one's presence in the Force or outright render them invisible. Thus, it was not only a unique method for [[Force healing/Legends|Force healing]], but was also another manner of [[Force stealth|Force concealment]] or [[Force cloak|Force camouflage]].

==Users==
Vergere used her powers to give her tears healing properties, which helped [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] in combating the [[coomb spore]]s she was infected with. She managed to teach the art to [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Cilghal]]. [[Onimi]], jester to [[Shimrra Jamaane]], also had this ability, but his level of control was much greater than Vergere's. He was able to amplify the current of energy flowing through his mismatched form, as well as compose deadly toxins and chemicals, able to be released through almost every aspect of his body; his blood, his sweat, his tears, his fang, and even his curving fingernails. These abilities allowed him to control Shimrra and become the true [[Supreme Overlord]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].

Jacen Solo taught the technique to [[Ben Skywalker]], who in turn taught it to his mother, [[Mara Jade Skywalker]]. Both used the ability to hide their presence in the Force. Mara described the technique to her husband, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] shortly before her death. [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]] also used this technique on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] to shrink her presence and follow a [[Querdan Dei|powerful dark side user]].
